name: yum
description: The classic RHEL-family package manager. On RHEL 8+ it is a compatibility alias for dnf; on RHEL 7 and CentOS 7 it is the real tool.

flags.description: Find the package that supplies a file.

examples.explanation: The RHEL 7-era update routine — identical semantics on dnf systems.
Adds the EPEL repository, unlocking thousands of extra community packages on RHEL-family systems.
Finds and shows the package providing the zip capability.

about: yum and dnf share the command surface, so knowledge transfers both ways. On RHEL 7 systems yum is the genuine package manager; from RHEL 8 onward typing yum simply invokes dnf.
useCases: Following older documentation that references yum.
mistakes: Expecting yum-only features (like plugins written for yum) on dnf systems.
distroNotes: RHEL/CentOS 7 and earlier as the native tool; alias to dnf on 8+.
